description:
Discovered during jit:894337e2 rework (pre-existing, unchanged by it): `jit serve --fg` deadlocks on repos where the child must acquire the bootstrap lock. `Serve { status: false }` sets `requires_recovery_dispatch` (cli.rs, added in jit:eceffc17), so the parent holds the `.jit-bootstrap` lock for its whole lifetime; in foreground mode it then blocks on `child.wait()`, starving the child's own recovery (5s lock timeout, child errors out). Daemon mode is unaffected because the parent exits right after spawning.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit serve --fg` serves successfully in a repository where the child performs bootstrap recovery: the parent releases its recovery session (or the child owns recovery) before the parent blocks on the child.
- [hard] REQ-02: Daemon-mode behavior is unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: A regression test covers the foreground path acquiring the lock end to end.
title: Foreground serve deadlocks: parent retains bootstrap recovery lock while blocking on child
